data.title: Good to know.
items: Who can see that I’m going?
Public plan pages show how many people are going, not who. Your host sees the guest list for their plan.
Hosts carry a verified mark. [How verification works, to confirm before launch.]
Can I really come on my own?
Yes, and most people do. Hosts plan a group, a team or a first hello so nobody stands on their own.
Tell your host on the night, then report it from your booking or on WhatsApp. Only our team sees your report. In an emergency, call 112.
What happens to a review I leave?
It appears on the host’s page, marked “Booked on Catch” because you booked. Hosts can reply.
